description: Create a phase plan for a workflow (despite the name, this does NOT create a context library — it creates the project plan that holds phases). A workflow can have at most one plan. Returns the new plan ID to use with add_phase. Alias: create_plan.

description.description: Optional short description of the project.

name.description: Project plan name (defaults to the workflow name if omitted).

spec.description: Optional full project spec stored on the plan record.

workflowId.description: Workflow ID to attach the plan to.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID. Defaults to your configured workspace.

name: create_project
